name: M3M Golf Hills
summary: The project, M3M as developer, the Sector 79 location and the Phase 1 RERA number GGM/704/436/2023/48 are confirmed, and the unit sizes broadly match. Possession differs: we say December 2028, but sources cite a RERA timeline to February 2031 and marketed dates of May 2030 or March 2028. Our ₹2 Cr starting price is more than 15% below every portal price found (lowest ₹2.43 Cr). Our tower and unit counts (26 towers, 1809 units) also match no source.

checks.note: The sources disagree with each other. No source states December 2028, and the dates closest to a RERA date (February 2031) and the Square Yards date (May 2030) are more than a year later than ours.

checks.note: Even the lowest figure found (₹2.43 Cr) is about 18% above our ₹2 Cr, and most portals quote ₹3.6 Cr or more. The 99acres figure comes from a search snippet because the page returned 403.
